prompt.extra: Make its natural coat about 50% fluffier: plush, cloud-like fur that puffs out on the legs too (fluffy feathering on the front legs, fluffy britches on the hind legs, little tufts between the toes), a puffy chest ruff, cheek fluff and a bushy tail, with visible individual strands and soft wispy edges everywhere. The legs must look as furry as the body, never smooth, sleek, shaved or thin.
